text: 1. Application Form: Fill in the "Application Form for International Students of Foshan University" online.(Clickable2 Passport: A scanned copy of a valid passport (including the information page, visa page, and entry and exit stamps).3 Graduation certificate and transcript: A high school or equivalent graduation certificate/academic qualification certificate, along with the corresponding transcript. If the version is not in Chinese, a Chinese translation must be attached.4. Physical examination report: The template for the physical examination report is attached.5 Photo: One recent (within the last three months) electronic ID photo.6. Transfer certificate: If you are already studying at another domestic university at the time of application, you need to provide a transfer certificate along with your transcript.7. If necessary, additional necessary materials may be added.
